name: Node (prebuilt image) — pinned toolchain, provenance-verified, with Claude Code
description: The `node` template's toolchain as a prebuilt, signed, multi-arch image: pnpm, prek, a GitHub CLI verified via SLSA build provenance (cosign), zsh and the Claude Code CLI. No local build — the config, extensions and lifecycle commands travel with the image. Ships an optional renovate.json wired to a shared preset.
